signatureStream.encoding: 32 raw SHA256 bytes per observation; sample schedule specified by run/preflight record
signatureStream.inputEncoding: receiver-major, rotor-major, source-major excluding self; UInt16LE predicate bits: bit0 downstream>0; bits1-7 signed margin>=0 in category order; then one tilt>=0 byte per drone. Inactive pairs included; signature changes need not change field

audit.coverage: All ordered receiver-rotor/source pairs including those outside field neighbor support; domain guard applies only to production eligible pairs. Full per-pair margins are evaluated, not serialized.

controllers.encoding: little-endian Float64; integer bit masks are exact
controllers.meaning: Commands and branch inputs at each actual nonterminal controller event; vectors/constraint normals can be reconstructed only where full state was retained

signatureSchedule: Initial accepted endpoint then each accepted endpoint; production refresh aliases the same index; no terminal refresh.
